2026-11-03: /themes/services shipped as LIVE-2130 at app/(marketing)/themes/services/page.tsx. This row's probe still looks for app/themes/services/page.tsx; repointing it waits on the owner's phrase. The picker entry stays hidden like House of Fates until Services is offered.

2026-11-04: owner: "Put services in the theme picker." Services leaves RETIRED_FROM_PICKERS (lib/theme/site-style.ts), so the gallery, the editor's Theme tab and the create wizard offer it (after New World and the others, in SITE_THEME_DEFS order). The /themes gallery card shows the real website and Spotlight renders and counts the sixteen trade kits; /themes/services is indexed and in the sitemap. The probe now checks the real route, the picker set and the sitemap.
